Team in SF and China, English and Mandarin. Know a US importer buying from China? Send them our way: one photo of a part, and we will name their factory. donkey.trade

name: Rex
long_description:
Rex is an AI-native service for order to cash. We replace people-heavy operations with AI agents that continuously manage invoices, customers and exceptions.

Order to cash is a $60B outsourced function because the work is too messy for traditional automation. Every customer has different context, exceptions do not follow clean rules, and the next step is often buried in emails, portals, handoffs, or someone’s memory. Rex agents run continuously in the background and resolve work to SLA standards so cash keeps moving. We're live with pre-IPO tech companies, managing  >$500m in receivables from F100 companies, cutting manual follow-up cycles from weeks to hours.

We founded Rex after spending four years building Sequence, an a16z-backed finance ops platform, from zero to Series A — where we saw firsthand that at-scale, O2C still runs on manual labour.

Rex is the #1 winner of the Vercel AI Accelerator out of 2,500 teams, selected by Guillermo Rauch and leaders from OpenAI, Anthropic, Browserbase and more.

name: Prized
long_description:
Prized lets non-engineers build, deploy, and share secure internal tools with AI, no engineering required. You don't need to know where the data lives, what APIs to use, or which connectors you need. Just describe what you want (a customer lookup, a dashboard, an approval flow), and Prized builds the tool on top of the right company data inside a governed boundary.

The people who feel the pain of missing internal tools most are non-engineers. They understand the workflow best but are blocked by the software layer, so they wait on engineering, duct-tape spreadsheets together, or increasingly rip company data into Claude Code and Cursor with no thought to permissions, sharing, or governance.

Prized makes security the default, enforced in the infrastructure rather than left to whoever built the tool. Each tool gets access only to the tables and integrations it was explicitly granted, credentials are workspace-scoped so tools can't cross org boundaries, and outbound calls go through a controlled layer. 

As an employee builds and shares, a teammate forks it and re-points it at their own data, and over time the company builds up a library of governed tools it actually owns.

Hudson was founding engineer at Gander (F24, acquired by Archer), then full-stack at Suno. Marinos studied CS and ME at Stanford and was on the same Gander team.
one_liner: Lovable for internal tools

Evaluate the captured traces and set a benchmark for success. Every future model switch meets or exceeds it in A/B testing.

Train and fine-tune a new model on prompts and weights you always own. Start locally and scale into cloud-hosted processes as you see success.

Deploy a new model only when the held-out eval is beaten. Serve it wherever you want. Production data feeds back into training and compounds performance over time.

Test. Learn. Deploy. Repeat.

name: Rise Reforming
long_description:
Geopolitical conflicts and natural disasters frequently expose the vulnerability of the American chemical industry. The reason? Production is centralized and fossil fuel-dependent. The solution? Localized production using an undervalued resource: biogas. The US produces enough biogas to make over $20 bn/y worth of chemicals, but 60% is wasted in low-margin applications or flared altogether.

Rise Reforming is commercializing a modular process to transform this underutilized biogas on-site into cheap, supply-secure chemicals. Our beachhead market is dimethyl ether (DME), used as an aerosol propellant and a low-carbon fuel additive in propane. Our target market is methanol: an established billion $ chemical and the future of low-carbon shipping.

We're doing our pilot project at a Chicagoland wastewater plant. This will be the first wastewater biogas-to-methanol demo in the Americas.

We're hiring for a senior chemical process engineer. Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/rise-reforming/jobs/wJ9Q9nv-senior-chemical-process-engineer
one_liner: We turn waste gases into valuable supply-secure chemicals

name: Floracene
long_description:
Floracene shows independent surgery centers the best-priced equivalent implant for every procedure based on their manufacturer contracts. 

Every orthopedic surgeon we've talked to says the same thing: 90%+ of expensive implants they use are clinically interchangeable, but the choice comes down to habit, brand comfort, or the device rep. US surgery centers spend ~$7B a year on implants, and in orthopedic and spine cases the implant alone runs ~40-60% of the total cost of the procedure. Roughly ~20-30% of that spend is recoverable by switching to a clinically-equivalent device. Instead of defaulting to the implant they trained on, a surgeon sees the 3+ equivalent options side by side and switches to the one that protects the case's margin.

Asaph and Jonah met on the hospitals team at Palantir two years ago, and have each spent the last four years in the plumbing of US healthcare: claims, eligibility, and payor contracting. Asaph was an early PM at Garner. Jonah was a founding engineer at Metriport (YC S22) after starting his own fax-automation startup for fertility clinics.

At a big hospital the surgeon picks the implant but isn't spending their own money, so price doesn't impact the decision. At an independent surgery center the physicians own the economics, so a cheaper equivalent goes straight to their bottom line. They have every incentive to switch. They just don't have the information or the tooling.
one_liner: Optimized medical device purchasing for independent providers

Simply install and connect your services to begin doing trusted agentic data work. We also offer VPC & on-prem deployment options for when data can't leave your boundary.

name: Definite
long_description:
Definite builds AI agents that generate the reports banks and financial institutions file with their regulators. Before any number lands in a filing, our verification engine checks it independently. Every line gets recomputed from ledger records and checked against a versioned rulebook, and wrong outputs go back to the agent with the reason, like compiler errors. They don't ship.

We met our first year studying computer science at the University of Waterloo, and interned at Meta, Optiver, and BitGo, places where one unverified number in a filing has real consequences. At BitGo, attestations proving customer assets matched the ledger were assembled by hand every period. At Optiver, daily regulatory numbers were rebuilt manually because nothing downstream took them on faith.

Today a controller pulls data from the core system into Excel and maps it to the report line by line. By the regulators' own estimate, one quarterly filing takes weeks. The software banks buy for this validates formatting, not truth: a loan mapped to the wrong schedule line passes every check it runs, and an executive personally signs the result.

This is hard because verification has to be independent of the model doing the work. Recomputing every number from source records is the only check a regulator or auditor will accept, and it's why DeepSeek v3 with our engine beats GPT-5 on public reporting benchmarks.

Every regulated institution files these reports, forever. Whoever proves the numbers owns the layer the filings, the audits, and eventually the books themselves depend on. We build it, and the agents that run on it.
one_liner: The most accurate financial agents for reporting

name: Cerenovus
long_description:
Cerenovus is a company brain. We aggregate every kind of file a company produces — documents, PDFs, emails, Slack messages, spreadsheets, meeting notes — and convert them into a single markdown knowledge graph with native AI-agent integration. A company's information becomes uniformly readable both by humans and by the AI agents working inside the graph.

On top of that foundation, Cerenovus maps the company as a system, drawing connections between the people, processes, and tools that make up real workflows. From that systems map, it infers where operations are inefficient and how to improve them.

In practice, this tool will help executives make better decisions. Whenever a leader has to act on a question — how to restructure a team, whether to keep a vendor, or where handoffs between teams are breaking down — Cerenovus will give them an evidence-backed answer in minutes rather than weeks.

Today, that work is done by consultants, by internal analysts, or by the executive asking around informally. Each of those approaches is slow, partial, and goes stale the moment it is delivered. Cerenovus produces the same answers faster, at a fraction of the cost, and keeps them live as the company evolves.
one_liner: A knowledge company

name: Molagri
long_description:
Molagri develops safer, more effective pesticides for agriculture.

We design biopesticides that hit a precise molecular target unique to pest insects, knocking out pests while sparing pollinators, beneficial insects, and the wider ecosystem. By modeling how pests are likely to evolve, we stay a step ahead of resistance, keeping our products effective against the pests of today and tomorrow. The higher efficacy and biobased production will also contribute to emissions reductions in both manufacturing and field use.

Our founders are PhD lab mates from the University of Toronto who have worked together for six years and published in Nature Communications and Nature Microbiology.
one_liner: Resistance free pesticides.

name: FlowManual
long_description:
FlowManual is the all-in-one AI bidding and purchasing platform for both general and specialty construction contractors.

Built by two engineers and Harvard dropouts, FlowManual automates the buying process during pre-construction. With FlowManual, specialty contractors win more work while general contractors deliver at higher standards.
one_liner: AI for Construction's Back Office.

name: Pluto
long_description:
Resumes made careers readable. LinkedIn made them searchable. Pluto makes them understood.

Professionals talk to Pluto for 10 minutes about what they’ve done, what they’re great at, and what they want next. Pluto makes that context discoverable to the right people and AI agents, helping them understand the professional more fully.

For hiring, companies tell Pluto who they want to meet. Pluto searches its network and the broader market, evaluates fit on both sides, privately confirms interest, and makes warm introductions when both sides want to connect.

18K+ professionals have shared their career context with Pluto. 100+ companies, from fast-growing startups to decacorns, use Pluto to meet people with deeper context and confirmed interest.
one_liner: AI voice agent that helps professionals get discovered

name: machine0
long_description:
machine0 is a CLI that lets you create, provision, and snapshot cloud VMs. `machine0 new my-vm` spins up a VM with dedicated CPU, RAM, and optional GPUs, plus a static IP and HTTPS endpoint. The tools agents need (e.g. Node, Python, Docker) and the agents themselves (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes) come pre-installed. 99.99% VM uptime SLA across four regions.

Agent workloads are moving from ephemeral to always-on. A coding agent debugging a complex issue runs 4-8 hours. OpenClaw runs 24/7. machine0 is the environment in which these agents run.
one_liner: Persistent & powerful cloud VMs from your CLI

name: Bloomy
long_description: Bloomy helps students learn more efficiently by using AI to identify exactly what a student should learn and when they should learn it. We provide adaptive and personalized curriculum to K-12, starting with English Language Arts, Math, and Writing.
one_liner: AI-powered mastery learning for K-12

name: 6thSense
one_liner: A nervous system for physical AI

name: Nori
long_description: We manufacture humanoid robots in San Francisco.
one_liner: Sub-1500$ robot anyone can program

name: Ooak Data
long_description:
The promise of AI agents is still unmet in complex, real-world business environments. Our mission is to make it possible for agents to reliably accomplish concrete and useful tasks.

That’s why we're building **Alexandria,** the world's largest library of real-world business workflow datasets.
one_liner: We build the world's largest library of real-world business workflow…

name: Greypoint Industries
long_description: Greypoint Industries builds mass-produced autonomous interceptors that defeat drone saturation for a fraction of the cost of the targets. We are developing a soldier-deployable, fire-and-forget interceptor built to give Western and allied forces the ammunition to counter mass drone swarm attacks.
one_liner: Manufacturing the future of autonomous swarm warfare.

name: Almanac
long_description: Almanac is a self-updating wiki for your coding agents. It turns your team’s AI coding conversations into connected Markdown docs that live inside your repo. Your agents automatically search the wiki before making changes, so every agent working on the codebase starts with the same context, decisions, and implementation history.
one_liner: Self updating wiki for your coding agents

name: Orvixo
long_description: Orvixo uses AI to build reactive end-to-end planning and optimisation models for manufacturers.
one_liner: AI advanced planning and optimisation for manufacturers.

name: Whitespace
long_description: Whitespace is the AI operating system for wholesale distributors. It connects to their systems and inboxes to build a living model of their business, then deploys self-improving AI agents to automate work like inventory planning, customer support, and order entry.
one_liner: AI Operating System for Wholesale Distributors

name: Vendo
long_description:
Vendo is the customization layer that lets your users build their own features and micro-apps directly on top of your product. Rather than waiting on an ever-growing feature backlog, your users can personalize the product to exactly how they work, create their own automations, and integrate hundreds of external tools, all without your team writing a line of code.

Everything runs on your existing API, renders natively in your own theme and components, and executes inside secure sandboxes within your existing security guardrails, so your source code is never touched. Companies can plug Vendo into an agent they already have, or deploy a production-ready agent complete with the ability to take actions in the product, generate UI, and draw on a built-in knowledge base. Vendo is open source and installs with a single command, and we work closely with teams to get it running for their product.
one_liner: Let your users build their own features on top of your product

name: Aktoria Robotics
long_description: Operate any robot, anywhere in the world.
one_liner: Human as API for robots

name: Rational
long_description: Rational builds AI coworkers for accounting firms. Our agents onboard themselves to the firm, build a company brain, and do the work, from month-end close to tax prep. In addition, they follow up with clients and communicate with the right members of your team.
one_liner: AI Employees for Accounting

name: Fabraix
long_description:
Fabraix builds state-of-the-art AI red-teaming agents that continuously detect security vulnerabilities in customer-facing AI. Our product, Nyx, has already found vulnerabilities in agents at dozens of Fortune 500 companies. On AgentHarm, the leading benchmark for offensive AI security, Nyx achieved a 78% attack success rate, compared with 67% for GPT-5.6 Sol.

Companies usually pay for penetration tests one project at a time. They select which systems to include, give a team a few weeks to find vulnerabilities, and receive a report when the project ends. Testing everything this way is very expensive. Globally, penetration tests cover only 26% of the software attack surface.

AI agents can change more often than teams can test them. A new model, prompt, tool, permission, or data source can change what an agent does, even when the application code stays the same. The report describes only the version that was tested. AI is also increasing how much software companies produce and how often it changes.

We built Nyx to automate this work. It does three things:
1. Nyx connects through the same interfaces customers use. It tests chat, voice, browser, and coding agents without source code or a special integration.
2. It draws on more than 10,000 jailbreaks that we have collected and classified, the largest such library we know of.
3. It uses each response to decide what to try next and can pursue a promising approach for hundreds of turns. In our tests, these adaptive attacks succeeded 20 times as often as attacks that were replayed unchanged or stopped after a fixed number of turns.

Nyx often finds its first vulnerability within minutes or hours rather than days or weeks. Because the work is automated, companies can repeat the test with every change and at much lower cost.

We're also the team behind ACE (Adversarial Cost to Exploit), a benchmark that measures AI security in terms of how much it costs attackers to break an AI system; providing a game-theoretic framework to understand how motivated a rational attacker would be in exploiting the system.
one_liner: The world's frontier hacker for AI agents.

name: Daqstra
long_description: Daqstra is the AI-native orchestration layer for physical R&D. It saves engineers in Aerospace, Energy and Robotics hundreds of man hours managing test infrastructure by connecting fragmented test hardware, bringing live and historical test data into one place, and by giving engineers an API to orchestrate their entire test setup. We enable teams to spend less time rebuilding test infrastructure and more time improving the hardware they test.
one_liner: AI-native orchestration for physical R&D testing

name: Risklytics
long_description: Risklytics is an AI-native brokerage for hard-to-place commercial insurance. We route each risk to the carriers that actually want it, collect the right information upfront, and send a complete package to the right underwriters the first time, so more risks bind with less back-and-forth.
one_liner: AI-Native Brokerage for Hard-to-Place Commercial Insurance

name: LATO
long_description:
The best investments come from conviction, and conviction comes from understanding a market deeply: its customers, its competitors, and where it's heading.

Today that understanding is slow and expensive to build. Reaching the right people takes weeks, a commercial study costs $300k+, and each one starts from scratch.

LATO does this research end-to-end, combining public data and the fund's own knowledge with first-hand interviews of a market's customers, experts, and operators. This research grounds a simulation of the market to predict how market participants behave.
one_liner: Agent-native research and simulation platform for investors

name: Vestris
one_liner: Replaces title searchers and closes property deals
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

name: Isengard Industries Inc
long_description:
Isengard Industries is not another drone company.

We build sovereign production: the means for allied nations to make precision-strike and counter-drone systems by the thousand, on their own soil, at a fraction of what the primes charge.

We call it Weapons of Mass Production. The Arsenal of Democracy, rebuilt for the drone age.

More to come, and only where it helps. You know how to reach us.
one_liner: Mass-produced AI strike systems and Counter-UAS

name: Denta
long_description:
Denta is the practice management platform that puts dental practices on autopilot. When a dentist starts a new practice, instead of finding an accounting firm, hiring two front desk workers, and then spending their nights posting insurance payments, they use Denta.

I started Denta to help operate my Dad's 10 practices in Iowa. In supporting those, I realized the most painful part was both people and agents having messy access to fragmented data. So I solved for that and now spend my time automating work for dentists!
one_liner: The dental practice that runs itself

name: Computable
one_liner: Buy, sell, and redeem GPU hours for any week with instant liquidity

name: Last Accounting Company
long_description:
Last Accounting Company (LAC) is a full-stack AI accounting firm. We sell the same service (bookkeeping, tax filings, etc.) as a traditional accounting firm, but underneath agents handle everything and a certified accountant signs off. Our service is faster, cheaper, and fully integrated, allowing our clients to focus on what matters, not accounting admin.

LAC replaces both outsourced accountants and legacy accounting software for startups and SMBs. Our system is fully proprietary, from the general ledger to the accounting agents. This allows us to create powerful self-reinforcing loops and ultimately provide a state-of-the-art accounting service.
one_liner: Agent-native accounting firm.

name: Markov
long_description: We source high quality tasks and data to train the next generation of computer use AI models.
one_liner: Data for computer-use ai

name: Cosmic Robotics
long_description:
Our mission is to build a city on Mars. 

Cosmic-1, the first equipment in our fleet, is an autonomous robot capable of heavy-lift manipulation. Its been deployed on some of the largest solar farms in the US, more than doubling labor productivity across tens of thousands of panel installs. 

We're scaling in solar, expanding in data centers, and building lunar construction robotics under contract with NASA.
one_liner: Autonomous construction on Earth and beyond

name: Operon
long_description:
Operon is the data intelligence layer for heavy industry. We ingest the messy documents a plant runs on (P&IDs, schematics, datasheets, scans) and turn them into one structured, queryable model of the facility.

On top of it, engineers query their plant in natural language and build agentic workflows for safety, compliance, and design.
one_liner: Agentic data layer for manufacturing & process industries.

name: Inkbox
long_description: We are building the identity and communication layer for AI agents: giving agents their own email, phone, iMessage, and internet address. Every interaction flows through Inkbox, so agents are enhanced with multi-channel context.
one_liner: Give your AI agents email, phone, iMessage and an internet address

name: ProvenMetal
long_description:
ProvenMetal manufactures the fastest circuit boards in the United States.

Domestic circuit board manufacturing is slow and expensive, and while reshoring is happening, the supply chain isn't there yet.

We automate the bottlenecks - part procurement, DFM review, and assembly - delivering circuit boards in days instead of weeks.
one_liner: Fast-turn, American made PCBs

name: Agentcard
long_description: Agentcard.sh is a debit card for AI agents. Agents can use Agentcard’s API to issue cards and pay for things online autonomously.

name: Agnost AI

Agnost AI helps teams building chat and voice AI agents understand what users want, where they get stuck, and why they drop off.

We read production AI conversations, cluster recurring intents, feature requests, frustration, and failure patterns, then open PRs against prompts, tools, and harnesses to improve the agent.

name: Care GP

name: Praxis AI

Embedded within publicly listed and unicorn-scale conglomerates, we reach 60k workers across 5 continents and 150+ environment types, supplying the real-world training data frontier labs and humanoid companies can't source anywhere else.

name: Levocred AI
long_description: Levocred AI is the Company Brain for credit teams — an AI employee that plugs into the fund's loan tape, credit agreements, servicer reports, and bank feeds, and runs the workflows analysts would otherwise grind on.
one_liner: AI for every workflow inside a credit team

name: Axelrod
long_description: Autonomous software for hotels that takes over all front-of-house and back-of-house tasks with zero integrations, running operations better than your staff would. Axelrod is trusted by Michelin Key awarded boutique hotels and is live across 4 continents.

name: Mireye
long_description:
AI agents are starting to act in the real world, but they can't reliably understand it. 

Geospatial data is complex, fragmented, and unstructured. Ask a model a specific question about a specific place and it guesses. Our API and MCP give agents cited answers about any location.

Our mission is to index every inch of the earth, and make it as queryable as the web.

name: 83 Sciences
long_description: 83 Sciences uses AI to mine discarded experimental data and drive scientific breakthroughs. Working alongside labs, we discover the materials that will power the new Industrial Revolution.
one_liner: AI-native materials discovery powered by unpublished experimental data

name: Skymerse
long_description: Skymerse is building one AI system for airline flight operations: from planning and monitoring in the operations center to real-time support in the cockpit. It is developing specialized aeronautical models that understand the data, constraints, and procedures behind each flight, replacing fragmented tools and manual interpretation. Notamify, its first product, already serves airline customers and thousands pilots and aviation professionals.
one_liner: Autopilot for Flight Operations

name: HyperProbe
long_description:
If your team uses Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex to ship, you've felt it: the AI is great at writing code, mediocre at debugging it. When something breaks in prod, you're back to grepping logs, adding console.logs, redeploying, and hoping the AI's guess is right.

HyperProbe fixes this. Your coding agent dynamically drops non-breaking probes into your running services, straight from your IDE. When a probe fires, HyperProbe captures and sanitises the exact variable state, feeding your agent real evidence instead of flat logs. 

This fixes prod incidents in minutes from the exact same window where agents write code, without ever redeploying to add a print statement. Under 1% CPU overhead. Automatic PII redaction. 

Built for backend teams shipping AI-written code today. Install in 60 seconds, see your first investigation in 10 minutes. That's why we call HyperProbe the runtime data layer for AI-native software.
one_liner: Your coding agent writes code. Now let it fix prod too.

name: OpenRelay
one_liner: Distributed, hardware-agnostic AI inference

name: Hop Aero
long_description: Hop Aero is building rocket cargo vehicles that deliver to contested environments hundreds of miles away in minutes. Our rockets fly point-to-point into the most austere locations at hypersonic speeds. Hop Aero's goal is to provide the U.S. and allies the asymmetric advantage that deters a future major conflict.
one_liner: Rocket cargo delivery to contested environments

name: Earendil Robotics
long_description:
Earendil Robotics builds cUAS solutions for the modern warfighter, enabling effective air defence at the small-unit level. We deliver spotting, engaging, and destroying capabilities through advanced sensors, autonomous interceptors, and integrated systems.

Our product lineup covers every stage of the kill chain, complemented by the Drone Warfare Academy that trains soldiers to eliminate enemy drone threats in contested environments.

Backed by worldwide frontline combat experience, we equip units with combat-proven tools to counter evolving aerial threats.
one_liner: Drone swarm defence at a small-unit level

name: Florin
long_description: Florin brings banking, payments, cards, and treasury into one account built for startups - so founders can hold, move, and grow their capital without stitching together half a dozen tools. Unlike platforms that resell another bank's rails, we're building the infrastructure ourselves, end to end, so money moves in real time on a single ledger we own. We start with an invite-only membership for venture-backed companies and expand from there. Named after the florin, the coin that anchored global trade for three centuries, with infrastructure built for how money moves now.

name: Justinian
long_description:
Justinian is an applied AI company changing the way companies and governments work together. 

Our first focus is building Justinian Government Affairs, an AI-native government affairs firm helping early-stage companies monitor regulations, lobby policymakers, and win government contracts.
one_liner: Builders of the first AI-native government affairs firm.

name: Petrarch
one_liner: Unlocking enterprise data for tomorrow's economy

name: SubVysion
long_description: We build centimeter-accurate 3D maps of underground utilities, to help construction contractors dig safer and faster. With underground intelligence, contractors can avoid utility strikes, which cause $30B in damages and 20 deaths every year in the US.
one_liner: We help contractors dig safer with 3D maps of underground…

name: Amulet
long_description:
Amulet helps post-sales teams monitor every account and automate the work that drives retention and expansion.

Our agents connect to customer data (CRM, support, product usage, and communication data) to flag churn risks, surface upsell opportunities, track adoption, and draft the right messages for each customer.
one_liner: Agents that drive customer success

name: OneCLI
long_description:
OneCLI is a credential isolation gateway for AI agents. Agents see placeholder tokens instead of real API keys and OAuth credentials, the real secrets are injected at the network layer, so a compromised or misbehaving agent can never leak them. 

Teams get per-agent access control, full audit logs, and one-click integrations with Gmail, GitHub, Jira, Slack, and 50+ other apps. OneCLI is open source (2.5K+ GitHub stars, 300K+ downloads), Already the default credential layer for products like NanoClaw.
one_liner: The Identity Gateway for AI Agents

name: Nex
long_description: Nex automates the messy business and GTM workflows that no tool could handle before, taking real actions across 1000+ integrations. Instead of just chatting, the agent writes code as it works to make workflows deterministic, fast, and cheap to re-run, and delivers real output: a Slack message, an opened PR, or a live structured data table. Built for teams.
one_liner: Claude Cowork with your model of choice

name: Robocurve
long_description:
Robocurve builds open-source tools and independent benchmarks to measure how well robots can do real-world jobs. Instead of relying on unverified demo videos from frontier labs, we score their models on reproducible benchmarks that anyone can trust.

Today there are no well-run, standardized robotics benchmarks. Labs evaluate in-house, and no independent group has stepped in to run continuous benchmarking as a service. The result is that no one actually knows how good anyone else is, or where the real frontier sits.

Good benchmarks require operating and maintaining physical hardware and real-world setups. Simulation only goes so far, since models that look strong in sim can show large performance gaps once deployed in the real world. Building real-world benchmarks means coordinating job-domain experts, evals engineering, and hands-on robotics all at once.

Frontier labs are targeting general-purpose robotics by 2028, yet the field of robotics evals barely exists. Whoever builds the trusted measure of robot capability becomes the reference everyone relies on. We combine backgrounds in AI evals and robotics to build and grow this field as fast as possible. We already shipped v1 of our open-source framework, Inspect Robots, and ran our first pilot scoring a frontier model on a real robot.
one_liner: Evaluating robots in the real world.

name: Salem Robotics Inc
long_description: Our software turns any robot we deploy into an everyday independent worker at your facility. They are able to walk sites, handle instruments, overcome obstacles, collect measurements, and generate auditable compliance records, replacing hours of manual surveys and inspections. Built by Los Alamos robotics veterans and deterministic-manipulation researchers, we're starting in nuclear and expanding to other hazardous industries.
one_liner: We deploy robots for inspections in hazardous spaces, like nuclear.

name: Osseus
long_description:
Osseus is the secure research brain for R&D teams. Today, research knowledge is fragmented across specialist tools, decisions, conversations, and people's heads. Osseus crafts this into a permissioned memory that grows with every experiment, decision, failure, and lesson learned. Rather than only retrieving the current state of connected tools, Osseus preserves how work evolved: what was tried, what failed, why decisions were made, and who holds the relevant context.

Each person gets a personal AI agent that uses this growing history to proactively surface relevant evidence, help prevent duplicated work and repeated mistakes, and identify the exact expert who can unblock the next decision. By preserving both technical history and the organizational know-how behind team processes and decision making, Osseus helps R&D teams move faster before time and money are wasted.
one_liner: The secure research brain for accelerating R&D

name: hardware intelligence
one_liner: Agentic chip design with ultrafast feedback loops

name: Billow AI Labs
long_description:
Billow handles the work of Accounting and FP&A FTEs while keeping teams compliant and audit-ready. We work within existing stacks (NetSuite, Coupa, and 80+ other systems) and complex spreadsheets, chasing down information and coordinating approvals across stakeholders. 

Built by repeat founders; Joan built and exited an accounting/ERP platform (45,000 businesses in 4 years) and Phil built Bloomberg's financial “brain” data infrastructure, and as CTO of a trading platform ($1B in volume). Advisors include CFOs, controllers, auditors from publicly-traded biopharma, and a Big-4 Accounting firm.
one_liner: AI-native Accounting & Finance Firm to Replace the Big-4

name: Coasty
long_description:
Coasty is a computer use agent that does real work inside softwares, companies already run. New web apps, old desktop tools, the legacy systems nobody wants to touch. You hand it a workflow and it owns the outcome.
Most agents demo well and break the moment they hit real software. They get 18 steps out of 20 right, misclick once, and everything after is garbage. Coasty catches when it goes off track and fixes itself mid-task instead of starting over. It handles the messy parts, benchmarks never show. Permission dialogs, surprise pop-ups, a modal that steals focus, a page that loads slow. When a vendor pushes an overnight update and moves half the menus, brittle scripts break by morning. Coasty reads the screen instead of recording clicks, so it adapts and keeps going.
It also checks its own output and leaves a time-stamped trail you can replay. We won't pretend it gets every task right. Nothing automating this work does. What matters is what happens when something breaks. It catches the mistake, fixes what it can, and flags what it can't so a person can step in. Nothing fails quietly. That's what lets a team trust it on the work where a silent error gets someone fired.
We scored 82% on OSWorld, which puts us among the most reliable agents out there. Reliability is the whole product, not a feature.
one_liner: The computer-use agent that doesn't break on real software. We will…

name: Edviro
long_description:
Edviro helps facilities managers at large buildings save on their energy bills. Facilities managers are overwhelmed with dashboards, alarms, and analytics for hundreds of boilers, HVAC units, and heat pumps across their buildings. Edviro continuously monitors and optimizes buildings using energy world models to detect anomalies, simulate interventions, and suggest the best options to the facilities manager.  Once the changes occur, we create a comprehensive M&V report to ensure savings show up on the bill. 

Our tools also allow institutions to maintain detailed service history & equipment logs, and perform maintenance with AR.
one_liner: Energy world models that fix energy waste before it becomes expensive.

name: Experiential Labs
long_description: An applied research lab building AI that is 90% cheaper while matching the performance of frontier models. We do this by simulating reality faster and more accurately based on the technology self-driving uses to get near perfect reconstruction fidelity.
one_liner: World models for agents

name: Conifer
long_description: Conifer is one app that connects you to every AI model (local and cloud) and automatically routes each request to the cheapest model that accomplishes your goal. Most requests run free on your own hardware, so teams cut their AI bill by ~80% while replacing a dozen provider contracts with one interface and one invoice. For sensitive material like financials or user data, a secure mode pins everything on-device with no external API calls.
one_liner: Local-first least cost routing system to reduce 80%+ token spend
